initial_external_guards.classification: Primary gain>=.0005 and H12 loss<=.001 vs V3champ, 4/6 nonnegative primary windows, inspect class/stream/EF/volume. A novel family can advance with stronger H12 evidence if primary tied, explicitly document before upload.
initial_external_guards.regression: Primary gain>=.03, H12 degradation<=.05,4/6 nonnegative windows, primary/H12tail+missing harm<=.25. Alternative justification must precede external score and preserve failure evidence.
